title: OlmoEarth v1.2: A more efficient family of OlmoEarth models
abstract: arXiv:2605.20804v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a set of improvements to the OlmoEarth family. These improvements allow us to cut compute costs during training ($3.0 \times$ reduction in GPU hours required to train our Base models) and inference ($2.9\times$ reductions in MACs on Sentinel-2 tasks), while maintaining the models' overall performance. All training code is available at github.com/allenai/olmoearth_pretrain.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.20804v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们提出了一系列对OlmoEarth模型家族的改进。这些改进使我们能够在训练过程中削减计算成本（训练我们的基础模型所需的GPU小时数减少了3.0倍），并在推理过程中降低计算量（在Sentinel-2任务上的MACs减少了2.9倍），同时保持模型的整体性能。所有训练代码可在github.com/allenai/olmoearth_pretrain获取。
